title: Drug store pharmacy license renewal cycle
rule_summary: A Massachusetts Drug Store Pharmacy license is renewed in the form and manner determined by the Board and expires on December 31 of each odd-numbered year following the date of issuance. This facility-license cycle is distinct from the personal pharmacist registration cycle.
exam_relevance: Tests facility renewal timing and prevents substitution of the pharmacist's personal-license schedule.

numeric_facts.value: December 31 of each odd-numbered year following issuance

common_confusions: Personal pharmacist registrations and drug-store pharmacy licenses use different renewal cycles.
verification_notes: Current official Massachusetts authority verified during Pre-Batch3 T2 authoring on 2026-08-18; fresh independent legal and realism audit is still required before release.
